policy: Latest available stable releases compatible with upstream requirements; preserve the MySQL 9.7 server line, security overrides, the local deepmerge fix and existing CI security gates. No prerelease runtimes or forced incompatible transitive upgrades.

previousAudit.note: The previous inventory, validation and scan results remain in Git history and are not evidence for this update.

localPackages.name: deepmerge
localPackages.reason: Existing security fix retained; upstream replacement requires the existing Swagger and merge regression tests.

actionsReview.result: All 13 latest stable action releases and tag commits verified. Updated actions/create-github-app-token to v3.4.0; CodeQL bundle tags are not action releases.

constrainedUpdates.reason: pestphp/pest 5.3.7 explicitly conflicts with phpunit/phpunit >13.4.7; verified with Composer prohibits.

compatibilityChanges: Composer requires PHP ^8.5.13 and resolves against PHP/ext-xsl 8.5.13. Both application Dockerfiles pin the same official multiarchitecture PHP 8.5.13 image.
@testing-library/jest-dom 8.0.0 supports Vitest 5 and removes support for earlier Vitest majors; this project uses Vitest 5.1.1.
Preserved npm security overrides, the local deepmerge package, and the opt-out for @scarf/scarf. The existing msw script allowance now names 3.0.7.
Node 26.13.1, Composer 2.11.2, phpredis 6.3.0, Xdebug 3.5.3, Playwright 1.65.1, MySQL 9.7.4 and Redis 8.10.3 remain the latest stable releases within the supported lines.
Refreshed Composer and Traefik image digests at the same version. Nginx updates to 1.31.9. F-UJI retains its verified 4.0.1 base with four compatible Python updates.

mysql.gate: not part of the existing application/Nginx/F-UJI CI gate

mysql.reason: No newer official MySQL 9.7 image is available. MySQL 9.7.4 remains pinned; the current official image contains fixable operating-system, mysqlsh Python and gosu Go dependencies. No server downgrade, custom replacement or vulnerability suppression was introduced.

validationCorrections: The initial Vitest startup found root-owned generated Wayfinder files. Restored ownership to www-data for the generated actions/routes/helper and reproduced successful generation before rerunning the full frontend check.

Reproduced the Laravel DatabaseManager teardown failure in isolation, adapted connection-only DB facade mocks to partial mocks, and verified all five affected CI paths before the complete backend run.

An initial Pint read failed for PortalMapClusterServiceTest.php during validation activity in the shared workspace. The file was present and readable; its focused Pint check passed, followed by the complete backend check.
